📊 知识库概览





























类别数量💡 灵感$= dv.pages('"💡 灵感阁"').length📚 读书笔记$= dv.pages('"📚 读书笔记"').length🎓 学习笔记$= dv.pages('"🎓 学习笔记"').length🔧 问题记录$= dv.pages('"🔧 问题记录"').length📔 日记$= dv.pages('"📔 日记"').length

💡 最近灵感
TABLE WITHOUT ID
    file.link AS "灵感",
    created AS "时间"
FROM "💡 灵感阁"
SORT created DESC
LIMIT 5

🔧 待解决问题
TABLE WITHOUT ID
    file.link AS "问题",
    created AS "发现时间"
FROM "🔧 问题记录"
WHERE status != "已解决"
SORT created DESC
LIMIT 5

📚 读书笔记
TABLE WITHOUT ID
    file.link AS "书名",
    created AS "创建时间"
FROM "📚 读书笔记"
SORT created DESC
LIMIT 5

🎓 最近学习
TABLE WITHOUT ID
    file.link AS "主题",
    created AS "学习时间"
FROM "🎓 学习笔记"
SORT created DESC
LIMIT 5

📔 最近日记
TABLE WITHOUT ID
    file.link AS "日记",
    created AS "日期"
FROM "📔 日记"
SORT created DESC
LIMIT 7

⚡ 快捷入口





























操作方式📔 今日日记Ctrl+P → 搜 打开今天的日记💡 捕捉灵感Ctrl+P → 搜 快速灵感📚 写读书笔记Ctrl+P → 搜 读书笔记🔧 记录问题Ctrl+P → 搜 问题记录🎓 记学习笔记Ctrl+P → 搜 学习笔记

最后更新：$= dv.date(new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0])
